Exact evidence_health._is_context_only treats context_only=null, empty string and empty list as context-only (fail closed), while runner._scoring_history and handoff._is_context_only use bool(value), classifying all three as scoring. FlowObservation.to_dict/from_dict preserves these provenance values through JSONL, so this is a source-confirmed cross-surface integration gap, not merely an in-memory hypothetical. The existing string-' false ' mismatch remains.

test_only_contract.source:
import json
import pytest
from part2.capital_flow.contracts import FlowObservation
from part2.capital_flow.runner import run_once
from part2.capital_flow.storage import append_observations

@pytest.mark.parametrize("provenance,scoring", [
    ({}, True), ({"context_only": False}, True),
    ({"context_only": True}, False),
    ({"context_only": " false "}, True),
    ({"context_only": "TRUE"}, False),
    ({"context_only": "maybe"}, False),
    ({"context_only": None}, False),
    ({"context_only": ""}, False),
    ({"context_only": []}, False),
])
def test_role_integrity_no_network(tmp_path, provenance, scoring):
    obs = FlowObservation(
        family="exchange_btc", metric="btc_netflow", asset="BTC",
        value=12.0, unit="BTC", effective_at_ms=1800000,
        available_at_ms=1900000, observed_at_ms=2000000,
        source="fixture_source", source_record_id="one",
        cadence_seconds=300, provenance=provenance,
    )
    append_observations(tmp_path / "observations.jsonl", [obs])
    result = run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, network=False, as_of_ms=2100000)
    assert result["source_errors"] == []
    assert result["archive_records_loaded"] == 1
    assert result["scoring_records_loaded"] == int(scoring)
    handoff = result["anata_output"]
    family = handoff["families"]["exchange_btc"]
    health = handoff["evidence_health"]["families"]["exchange_btc"]
    assert family["scoring_observation_count"] == int(scoring)
    assert family["context_observation_count"] == int(not scoring)
    assert health["scoring_observation_count"] == int(scoring)
    roles = [x["role"] for x in handoff["source_evidence"]
             if x["family"] == "exchange_btc" and x["source"] == "fixture_source"]
    assert roles == (["scoring"] if scoring else ["context"])
    for filename in ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json"):
        assert json.loads((tmp_path / filename).read_text())["as_of_ms"] == 2100000
